observation.command:
for c in "risikohinweis-service:risk_assessment" "ki-guv-feedback:feedback_api" "dokumentensuche:src.main"; do
  img=${c%%:*}; mod=${c##*:}
  echo "=== $img ==="
  timeout 60 docker run --rm --entrypoint sh "$img" -c "ls /app/.venv/bin/ | grep -iE 'risk|feedback|dokumenten'; /app/.venv/bin/python -c 'import ${mod}; print(\"import ok\")' 2>&1 | tail -1"
done
